note: QR print rules for tool 4. Quiet zone is fixed by ISO/IEC 18004; the size and module guidelines are industry rules of thumb, not standards.

quietZone.source: ISO/IEC 18004 (QR Code): quiet zone of 4 modules on every side
quietZone.note: GS1's 2D table states 1X for QR with GS1 Digital Link; we keep the ISO/IEC 18004 rule of 4 modules, which satisfies both.

sizing.source: Scanova: minimum QR code size (10:1 scan distance rule, 2 x 2 cm minimum)

module.source: GS1: Solution provider 2D readiness (GenSpecs 2025 figs 5.12.3.1-3, 5.12.3.3-2): QR Code with GS1 Digital Link, X min 0.396, target 0.495 mm

contrast.source: ISO/IEC 15415 symbol contrast grades (A >= 70%, B >= 55%, C >= 40%, D >= 20%)

logo.source: Error correction level H restores about 30% of the symbol (ISO/IEC 18004); logo kept to 20% of the width (4% of the area) for margin

gs1DigitalLink.source: GS1 Digital Link Standard: URI Syntax, release 1.7.0 (sections 4.5, 4.9, 4.10)
gs1DigitalLink.note: GTIN always 14 digits (leading zeros); path order /01/{gtin}/10/{lot}/21/{serial}; expiry in the query string ?17=YYMMDD.
